verdict.rationale: uv documents several of its own bulk operations. `uv add -r` adds every dependency from a requirements.txt in one command, `uv cache clean` clears the whole cache, and `--refresh` revalidates cached data for all dependencies on any command. A community user, however, reports no elegant way to bump all dependencies at once and had to script it, so bulk support is uneven across item types. Missing for 10: a documented bulk upgrade of all dependencies or all installed tools, bulk operations across workspace members, and independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
